items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I did it with Chu Berry, the tenor player, in mind -- Leon "Chu" Berry.

ctx.x: production from the record store. And it was called Modern Records at the time. The Bihari Brothers, Jules, Joe and Sol. They had this little record store, and decided to go into the record thing.

And the first thing that we recorded was a thing called "Deep Meditation" with Howard McGhee. I actually was trying to emulate Coleman Hawkins to a degree, because he had just finished working with Hawkins, and he had told me about how this song...he could imagine Hawk doing it, you know. So I tried to emulate Coleman Hawkins to a degree on "Deep Meditation." In fact, that's about the only time I ever tried to do somebody else on a record. Except one time later on when I did a movie soundtrack, and the setting…
